c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
print('all',np.mean((X@c-y)**2)/np.var(y))
# greedy forward selection
sel=[]
for step in range(8):
    best=None
    for k in names:
        if k in sel: continue
        Xs=np.column_stack([F[j] for j in sel+[k]])
        cc=np.linalg.lstsq(Xs,y,rcond=None)[0]
        e=np.mean((Xs@cc-y)**2)/np.var(y)
        if best is None or e<best[0]: best=(e,k)
    sel.append(best[1]); print(step,best)
